parameters.content:
## 1. Validate the reusable request
The gateway sends a request ID, session, selected agent, current instruction, bounded durable history, and up to three bounded documents. This node validates all of them before anything can reach Claude.

An exact `CONFIRM XXXXXXXX` phrase takes the deterministic confirmation branch; every other valid request takes the document-, history-, and skill-aware agent branch.

## 4. Keep the response contract stable
The final node returns only:

- `sessionId`
- `reply`
- `runId`

The browser depends on these names. Do not return credentials, raw provider errors, or execution data.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { sessionId: $('Validate and Normalise').first().json.sessionId, reply: String($json.output ?? '').slice(0, 8000), runId: String(typeof $execution === 'undefined' ? '' : $execution.id) } }}

parameters.content:
## 2. Durable history, documents, skills, Claude, and narrow tools
The gateway supplies up to six completed turns from local SQLite. The context builder labels that history, wraps each document in an explicit untrusted-data boundary, then adds the bundle produced from `skills/enabled.txt`.

The agent receives Claude, durable conversation context, one automatic read tool, and two proposal-only write tools. Documents and earlier messages cannot trigger a write by themselves.

## 3. Confirm before changing data
A write proposal returns a short phrase that expires in five minutes. Only the same browser session sending that exact phrase can consume it.

The confirmation subworkflow consumes the proposal before calling a reviewed worker. Old, changed, cross-session, expired, and repeated phrases cannot write.

parameters.description: Saves a standing instruction to be carried out later on its own: every morning, every weekday, weekly, monthly, or once on a named date.
